name: Bar Breaker
summary:
Step into Bar Breaker, a chaotic VR destruction game set inside a neon bar made for smashing, throwing, and breaking.
Grab objects, swing a bat, use the pistol, and wreck the room piece by piece. Bottles shatter, crates break apart, tables crash, barrels explode, and the bar becomes your personal VR smash room. Every hit is built around hands-on virtual reality interaction, giving you the freedom to cause damage your own way.
